newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain higher in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain higher in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained slightly higher on Monday, but brokers noted caution as the main index neared resistance around 6,950 points.
With 35 minutes left, the index was up 20.79 points or 0.30 percent to 6,924.69. Turnover was T$30 billion.

Brokers said they expected some window-dressing from mutual trust funds to help support the market. "But most other institutions have completed their window-dressing, so major gains are unlikely before the New Year holiday," said Nomura Securities analyst Ben Lee. Transport and plastics shares led the gains, but paper shares fell. -- James Peng (5080815)
